description: This file contains JavaScript functions 'step' and 'walk' that implement state transition logic for a state machine, including pattern matching, action evaluation, and state progression.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Advances the state machine to the next state based on current context, specification, state, and message, performing pattern matching and action evaluation.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Iteratively calls 'step' to advance the state as far as possible within a maximum step limit, accumulating emitted messages and tracking message consumption.
